No spec subject

Review: simplicity M1 + spec L2. Review.build_view switched to build_v2 in the epic; v1 CoverageClosure.build/2 (~80 lines) now has zero callers and zero tests, yet its docstring claims it is 'used today', and coverage_closure.ex retains a stale 'build_v2 not wired yet — T7's job' comment the spec correctly contradicts. Delete the dead path (or ADR-note why it stays), fix the comments.

- .spec/specs/** ONLY if the spec gate demands subject co-change for touched files
- .spec/state.json, .spec/realization_hashes.json (tool-managed baselines; regenerate via documented command only)

Out of Scope (files): all other lib/**, mix.exs, .github/**.

Out of Scope (intent): no behavior change to the live build_v2 path; do NOT touch binary_to_term safety (that is specled_-q6l.4, blocked on this ticket); do not refactor beyond the deletion; no new deps. Preference is DELETION — only keep v1 with an ADR note if you find a real reason it must stay (then say so in the completion record).

Verification:
1. Before deleting, record proof v1 build/2 has zero callers (grep) in the completion record.
2. mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean after deletion (orphaned private helpers also removed).
3. Targeted: mix test test/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure_test.exs green.
4. mix format --check-formatted; mix spec.check --no-run-commands green.
